data.name: Jishan
data.gender_notes: Jishan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jishan is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two words: 'Ji' meaning 'God' and 'Shan' meaning 'gracious gift'. It is a name given to signify that the child is a divine blessing and a gift from the Almighty. The name Jishan carries the meaning “God's gracious gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jishan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gracious gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jishan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's gracious gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jishan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
